objective: Implement deterministic reference-only break-even, trailing and dynamic protective-stop ratchets bound to exact current P21-A position state and current P21-B protection, without choosing universal trailing distances or mutating broker/OMS/Live state.
scope: Bind every adjustment request to exact current P21-A position_record_id and position_id
Require OPEN or PARTIALLY_CLOSED canonical position with positive exposure
Require current P21-B protection bound to the same exact canonical position record
Accept caller-supplied reference price and requested stop level without venue queries
Enforce monotonic protective-stop tightening: LONG stop may only rise; SHORT stop may only fall
Require BREAK_EVEN stop exactly at canonical average-entry floor and favorable reference price
Allow TRAILING and DYNAMIC_EXIT to tighten through entry into profit-lock territory
Require requested stop to remain strictly on the non-triggered side of caller reference price
Require caller reference price to remain strictly before the current take-profit trigger
Produce deterministic content-addressed reference protection-adjustment plans
out_of_scope: Choosing strategy-specific trailing distance, percentage, trigger timing or adjustment cadence
Direct mutation of P21-A canonical position state
Broker/exchange order placement, cancellation or modification
tests: LONG and SHORT BREAK_EVEN ratchets pass only at exact canonical entry with favorable reference
LONG stop cannot move lower or remain unchanged
SHORT stop cannot move higher or remain unchanged
TRAILING and DYNAMIC_EXIT may lock profit while preserving non-triggered geometry
Stop crossing or equaling caller reference price fails closed
Reference price at or beyond current TP trigger fails closed
Closed or zero-exposure positions fail closed
Mismatched or stale P21-B protection plan fails closed
No venue query, order mutation, OMS mutation or Live authority is emitted
P21-D evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P21-D package/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P21-A through P21-C remain canonical complete and P21-E remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Monotonic ratchet, exact lineage and non-triggered geometry tests pass
No universal trailing distance or percentage is encoded
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
Implementation PR merged and post-merge verified
